statesui.denied.title: macOS refused permission to read the folder
statesui.denied.reasonIn: Why: the folder is inside «{location}», and AYAR's permission to read it was refused. AYAR reads nothing from it until you allow it in System Settings, and reading runs nothing.
statesui.denied.reason: Why: AYAR's permission to read this folder was refused. AYAR reads nothing from it until you allow it in System Settings, and reading runs nothing.
statesui.denied.step1: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files and Folders.
statesui.denied.step2Folder: Turn on the folder under AYAR.
statesui.denied.step3: Come back to AYAR and press «Try again».
statesui.missing.title: The path is missing
statesui.missing.reason: Why: the folder is no longer where it was registered; it may have been moved, renamed or deleted. The earlier runs and evidence are kept in AYAR.
statesui.missing.reasonLastRead: Why: the folder is no longer where it was registered; it may have been moved, renamed or deleted. Last good reading: {date}. The earlier runs and evidence are kept in AYAR.
